name: Ashtanga Yoga Kendra (Bengaluru)
reason: Too thin and no usable contact route: its own site (ashtangayogakendra.com; robots.txt allows us) publishes phone/WhatsApp numbers and a new-student application form (to be filled only after speaking to the teacher), but no email and no contact form; its only offering is the Mysore and led class timetable (no prices, no workshops or trainings), and its home and about pages say the practice can cure suffering and offer therapy sessions on health issues. Teacher Gururaja Anemajal, Level 2 authorised, HSR Layout.
